other_failure_modes.name: OOF Leakage via Early Stopping
other_failure_modes.description: The agent uses the validation fold during cross-validation to early-stop a gradient boosting model (e.g., LightGBM), and then uses the predictions on that exact same validation fold for the out-of-fold (OOF) ensemble matrix. This biases the OOF predictions because the model was actively tuned on them via early stopping, leading to overfitting during the subsequent ensemble weight optimization.

summary: The agent provides a robust and well-structured solution featuring solid cross-validation, custom feature engineering, and a log-loss optimized ensemble. However, it suffers from two data leakage issues: computing the imputation median before the cross-validation split (leaking validation statistics into training folds), and early-stopping LightGBM on the validation fold while using those same biased predictions for out-of-fold ensembling.
